changes.before: For \emph{one correlation quadrature}, the naive finite-kick estimator has variance at most $1/(\lambda^4S)$ when $S$ shots are allocated equally across four independent bounded amplitude-quadrature estimates. For dimensionless normalised operators, $\lambda=0.1$ and quadrature standard error 0.01 give $10^8$ sufficient worst-case shots for one time and geometry. This is neither the budget for the complete complex correlator nor a necessary or measured cost. P's logarithmic chromophore encoding cannot be transferred to a molecular electronic active space.
